name: Bunbuns Moving Dragons Groving
source:
Dawn Setta is a young rabbit man living with his two dragon moms. Of course there is a problem he never saw coming. Their moving from his old home and to a new place out in the country and rabbits hate change. But when your mom is a nine foot tall milf of a dragon, and your less than four and a half feet tall, you do not argue with her. Especially when she shakes those dragon hips.

Will you survive the move? Or will everyone of your family members take a ride on the bunny train to prove their dominance? The choice is... probably not yours given the circumstance but you'll pretend you have a choice.

[From [url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/bunbuns-moving-dragons-groving]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
黎明塞塔是一个年轻的兔人，和他的两个龙妈妈住在一起。当然，还有一个他从未预见到的问题。他们从老家搬到乡下的新地方，兔子讨厌改变。但是，当你的妈妈是一个九英尺高的熟女，而你的身高还不到四英尺半时，你就不会与她争论。尤其是当她摇动那些龙臀的时候。

你能在这次搬迁中幸存下来吗？或者你的每个家庭成员都会乘坐兔子火车来证明他们的统治地位吗？在这种情况下，选择可能不是你的，但你会假装你有选择。

[来自[url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/bunbuns-moving-dragons-groving]Itch.io[/url]]
